text.description_html:
Baldwin Estates Collection R033 Passage Rose Pair

This is a Pair of Baldwin R033 Estate Rosettes. The R033 Rose is 3.225 inches high and 2.75 inches wide and has a beveled edge. It is designed to conceal 2.125 inch pre-drilled door bore hole. The Baldwin Estates Collection R033 Rosette is made out of solid forged brass.

Features and Specifications of the Baldwin R033 Rectangular Beveled Rose:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Rose Height: 3.225"
  • Rose Width: 2.75"
  • Designed to conceal 2-1/8" pre-bored doors

Sold as a pair (2)
